restoration_note: The teaching describes (a) the binding of the Watchers and the casting-off of their abortion-offspring, then their re-descent and the begetting of Adam from them; (b) Jesus the Radiance going down into the small body to bear up the Omophoros's withered shoulders, ordering wind/water/fire and opening the way of ascent; (c) a doctrinal parallel: every watching-place suffers shaking until enmity is humbled, both at cosmic and bodily registers. Most fills are tightly constrained by visible word-fragments, parallel formulas (line 32 ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ ⲛⲉⲥⲥⲉ parallels {27}/{28}; the ⲭⲱⲗⲭ + ⲁⲙⲁⲓ̈ⲏⲏⲥ formula recurs at lines 7–8), and standard discourse markers (ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲁⲏ, ⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ, ϩⲁⲡⲣⲁ). Six gaps remain unrestorable: {9} (partial ⲃⲉ ⲍ doesn't match standard formulas for 'Jesus saw the prayer'); {10} (9-char noun ending -ⲧⲥ before ⲛⲍⲟⲩⲍⲉ has no clear lexical anchor); {26} ({27}/{28} sentence is too damaged with only ⲡ...ⲱⲛ traces, and {37}/{38} reckoning-clause has no parallel formula in the surviving Manichean corpus to constrain them).

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor restoration completing ⲫⲉⲣⲣⲟⲕⲁⲧⲟⲭⲟⲥ from previous title-line; standard Manichaean cosmological term.
ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲉϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'came forth upward' is the standard Manichaean idiom for the Pillar of Glory's emanation; 4 chars (ⲣ-ⲏ-ⲓ̈) fits.
Plural article before ⲃⲟⲏⲑⲟⲥ.
ⲛⲍⲣⲏϣⲉ 'the burdens' borne by the Pillar of Glory and Omophoros — standard Manichaean cosmic-load terminology.
Completes ⲉⲓⲣⲏⲅⲟⲣⲟⲥ 'Egregoros' (Watcher) from previous line.
Perfect prefix completing ⲁⲩⲃⲱⲧⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'they expelled' — the four angels casting out the giant offspring of the Watchers.
Standard causal discourse-marker ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ 'since' opening the explanation of Adam's begetting.
Perfect 3pl prefix completing ⲁⲩⲭⲡⲟ 'they begot' (the abortions begot Adam and Eve).
Relative perfect ⲉⲧⲁϩϣⲱⲡⲉ 'which arose,' parallel to identical construction at line 24.
Partial trace 'ⲃⲉ ⲍ' does not match standard Manichaean formulas for 'Jesus saw/heard the prayer' (e.g. ⲁϩⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ ⲁ-, ⲁϩⲛⲁⲩ ⲁ-). No clear reconstruction.
9-char span ending in -ⲧⲥ before ⲛⲛ̄ⲍⲟⲩⲍⲉ has no clear lexical anchor; possibly a noun for 'form/cast/figure' but not constrainable.
ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲛⲁⲇⲁⲙ 'the mind of Adam' — standard Manichaean phrase for the awakening of Adam by Jesus; ⲙ̄ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ with definite article.
ⲡⲧⲏⲩ 'wind' — standard reading; restored from line 3 parallel where ⲡⲧⲏⲩ ⲡⲙⲁⲩ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ appear together.
ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'establish, fashion' — completes the verb of opening/preparing the way.
ⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ doublet 'once again' — standard discourse marker opening a new explanatory section.
Completes ⲃⲱϣ 'wither' verb + ⲛ̄ⲛⲧⲱⲟⲥ 'the shoulders'.
ⲉⲧⲙ̄ⲡⲱⲍ ⲛⲕⲱ 'have not reached respite' — Lyc reflex of ⲡⲱϩ 'reach,' fitting 3-char span and parallel imagery of shoulders unable to find rest under their burden.
ⲛ̄ⲉⲩⲥⲁ 'for an hour' — parallel to identical phrase at line 4 of the segment.
Completes ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ 'that' demonstrative + preposition ⲁ- 'to.'
ⲥⲱⲣⲟ̄ 'comfort/spread out' — verb of consoling fits the descent-to-strengthen context.
Completes ⲧⲁⲭⲣⲟ (=ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ) 'strengthen' — the standard verb for the Lord's bracing of the Omophoros.
ⲁϩⲉⲓ 'to come' qualitative — the rising-up motion of the strengthened shoulders.
Definite article + ⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ 'rest' — completes ⲡⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ 'the rest' as the goal of ascent.
Completes ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ 'the Zone' — the natural mind's complete circuit.
ⲛⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ relative converter introducing 'those over which the great Gods are masters.'
Completes ⲣ̄-ⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'watch over' — standard verb for the Gods' oversight.
4-char span at end of clause — could be discourse particle or temporal phrase, but no parallel formula constrains it.
10-char span with traces ⲡ...ⲱⲛ... — possibly ⲡⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ or ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ + modifier, but the parallel structure with the {28}ⲥⲏⲧⲟⲩ phrase (line 32 has ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ ⲛⲉⲥⲥⲉ) does not yield a confident reconstruction.
3-char span ending ⲛ̄ before ⲥⲏⲧⲟⲩ. Could be preposition ⲥⲛ̄/ⲍⲛ̄ 'in' or verb ending, but depends on unrestored {27}.
Completes ⲉⲫⲃⲓⲟ (=ⲑⲃⲃⲓⲟ) 'humility, humbling' — the state induced in the disordered body until enmity is laid low.
ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉϩⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ⲥⲏⲧ 'according to his purpose of heart' — standard collocation describing the Light Mind's redirection of the body.
ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'watching-stations/places' — same construction as line 25 within this teaching.
Final ⲉ completes ⲛⲉⲥⲥⲉ verb form — Sin casts (its disturbances).
Completes ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth, outwardly' — discernment revealed outwardly to the good faculties.
Lycopolitan relative converter ⲉϩ-/ⲉⲧ- introducing ⲥⲙⲁⲁⲛⲧ 'which is established.'
Purpose-conjunctive prefix ⲁ-ⲧⲟⲩ-ϯ 'that they may give' — introducing the verdict-clause.
ⲥⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲥⲁⲧⲉ 'in/with fire' — standard preposition + indefinite, the fire of love's purification.
4-char span at end of reckoning-clause — could be a qualifier ('as chosen,' 'rightly,' 'truly') but no parallel formula constrains it.
ⲛⲁⲙⲉ 'truly, indeed' — 4-char adverb ending in ⲙⲉ matching the partial trace, fitting 'truly they were first to stand in hidden goodness.'
Standard formula ϩⲁⲡⲣⲁ 'concerning the matter of' — opens a new exegetical question.
Genitival ⲛ̄-ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'of light' modifying ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ — 'the Mind of Light' (Light Mind).
Continuation of ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲩⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲙⲁ 'this small body.'
Independent pronoun ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲩ 'they (themselves)' — the gods, subject of 'are great strong ones.' 5 chars with macron.
Indefinite plural article ϩⲛ̄- before ⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛⲉ ⲛ̄ⲭⲱⲣⲉ 'great strong ones.'
Copular ⲛⲉ in 3pl predicate 'they are.'
Completes ϩⲫⲗⲓⲃⲉ (Greek θλίβειν 'oppress, afflict') from previous line — each god in oppression at his place.
Completes ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ 'in this place' — fits the locative ⲉⲧϩⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ ⲛϩⲏⲧϥ̄ 'in which he stands fast.'
Completes ⲭⲱⲗⲭ 'fashion, prepare' — the trees-image verb.
Lexeme uncertain; the parallel ⲡⲉϩ-ⲁⲙⲁⲓ̈ⲏⲏⲥ in line 203 supports a possessable noun meaning 'support/foundation' (cognate ⲁⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'grasp'). Each tree fashioned with its supports.
Article completing ⲡⲟⲩⲉ ⲡⲟⲩⲉ 'each one.'
Same lexeme as {48}, here with 3sg.m possessor: 'fashioned with his support' — the trees-and-soil image applied to each god in his place.
Feminine article ⲧ- before ⲧⲱϣ 'boundary.'
ⲧⲟ̄ⲁⲧ — Lyc reflex of ⲧⲱϣ 'boundary, ordained measure'; each god operates within his ordained place.
